    "Changing key handling may affect custom keyboard shortcuts that rely on ArrowUp/ArrowDown within the tab component."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that ArrowLeft and ArrowRight still move focus between tabs and update aria-selected accordingly.",
    "Verify that ArrowDown and ArrowUp do not change focus, aria-selected, or panel visibility.",
    "Ensure that screen readers still announce tab labels correctly and that scrolling behavior is unaffected when focus is not within the tablist."
  ]
}
